name: NorthPower Communications
summary: Telecommunications venture of NorthPower, the NSW electricity distributor for northern NSW (successor to Northern Rivers Electricity, principal office Port Macquarie); marketed telecom services over its electricity network in the late 1990s. No public record found of a retail internet service under this name; NorthPower merged into NSW government-owned Country Energy on 1 July 2001.

events.details: Trading name used by distributor NorthPower (renamed from NorthPower Energy under the Energy Services Corporations Act 1995; successor to Northern Rivers Electricity) for its telecommunications venture.

refs.label: Wales v Northpower [1998] NSWIRComm 35 — corporate lineage Northern Rivers Electricity → NorthPower Energy → NorthPower; principal office 9 Short St, Port Macquarie

events.details: Parent NorthPower merged with Advance Energy and Great Southern Energy to form Country Energy; the communications unit's fate under the merger is not separately recorded.
